entries.title: Annotate words in a card's choices
entries.body: Selecting words in one of a question's choices on a card now offers Annotate, as it does for the rest of the card. Selecting them leaves the choice as it was, and a click on a choice still picks it.

picture.alt: A card's question with the words check that failed selected in its one choice and an Annotate button under them, the choice's box still empty
